The '''''Giga''-class transport''' was an enormous model of [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ship that could carry thousands of passengers and cargo.

==History==
[[File:Ultimo_Vista.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Ultimo Vista/Legends|''Ultimo Vista'']], seen from above, glides over Coruscant's skyscrapers.]]
Some vessels of the class, like the [[Ultimo Vista/Legends|''Ultimo Vista'']], were converted to leisure cruise ships, big enough to hold apartment blocks, artificial lakes, and small seas.<ref name="ITWAOTC" />

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the ''Giga''-class continued in operation, with several seen around a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]].<ref name="STTAC" />
